messages:
maya_sales: Need a concise artifacts checklist for a regulated buyer to sign POC by Friday. They also asked if we can provide full pen-test report and whether reserved pricing is mandatory.

ian_ps: Minimal artifacts we provide: SOC 2 Type II attestation (or signed controls summary), pen-test attestation letter (signed) or redacted executive summary, UAT/staging network diagram, SSO/SAML integration notes with test account, staging IP whitelist or VPN details, and a short POC runbook with support hours and escalation.

ian_ps: Dedicated/reserved pricing is optional for POC. We can run on shared infra; if they want guaranteed latency we offer a short reserved window quoted separately.

rachel_security: Pen-test sharing: default is signed attestation + redacted findings summary. Full reports require NDA + legal approval + secure dataroom. Attestation includes scope, date, severity summary and confirmation of any outstanding criticals or remediation ETA for high issues. We will not share raw scanner logs or vendor PII.

rachel_security: If they insist on a full report, request CISO/legal contact and reason for full disclosure; we'll prepare a dataroom and need legal signoff. Security can sign technical attestations; legal signs contractual addenda.

noah_ops: Staging IPs: for quick POCs we give ephemeral CIDR blocks (2-week windows). Example whitelist: 18.210.33.0/28 ingress, 18.210.33.16/30 callbacks. Static public IPs are possible but need ~72 hours lead time and may impact billing if reserved infra is required.

maya_sales: Can someone condense this into a one-page checklist? Buyer asked: "is network diagram + SSO + pen-test attestation enough to sign off?"

ian_ps: Short answer: usually yes if attestation shows no open criticals and SSO validated end-to-end in staging. Proposed one-page checklist to send them: - SOC 2 Type II attestation OR signed controls summary - Pen-test attestation (signed) OR redacted executive summary (statement of no open criticals + remediation ETA for any high findings) - Network architecture diagram for UAT/staging (include any on-prem connectors) - SSO/SAML test user validated in staging - Confirmation of staging IP whitelist or VPN details - POC support hours & escalation contact - Optional: KMS/key custody statement if required by buyer

rachel_security: I'll attach the standard pen-test attestation template and can redline if their legal provides changes. Add line: "Full pen-test report available under NDA in secure dataroom; request legal/CISO contact."

noah_ops: Ping me if they want static IPs or a month-long reserved window and I'll open the ops ticket.

maya_sales: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" will send checklist and capture legal/CISO.
